name: Senco Gold Ltd
title: Senco Gold Ltd - 543936 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue grew 33% to INR8,430 Cr but inventory rose 61% to INR5,296 Cr (186-188 days), FCF negative; FY27 guide is 18-20% growth at 7.5-7.8% EBITDA, with a customs-duty inventory gain flattering FY26 margins.

triggers.label: Inventory days 186-188, up from 166
triggers.quote: Inventory days have increased to 186 days.

triggers.label: Total inventory up 61% to INR5,296 Cr
triggers.quote: our total inventory increased 61% Y -o-Y to INR5,296 crores.

triggers.label: Customs duty hike gives ~9% inventory gain
triggers.quote: this 9% gain, very simple, 6% to 15% is 9%.

triggers.label: Post-announcement footfall dip in May
triggers.quote: in the last 7 to 10 days, the footfalls at the stores have come down.

triggers.label: April growth ~67% on Akshaya Tritiya
triggers.quote: In April, during the Akshaya Tritiya and Poila Boishakh, we grew by 67% , and we achieved very high sales.

guidance.quote: our focus of 18% to 20% growth for the whole year
we are still giving the guidance of 7.5% to 7.8% for the future
18 to 20 stores is what we would like to open.
we would intend to keep it between 160 and 180.
north of 16%, 17% is a good target.
